text:
emma: New customer reported flaky quickstart. First chat call returned text, then immediately following embeddings call returned 402 Payment Required. They said they just signed up via SSO invite and then ran the sample app.

emma: Snippet from their logs: `chat ok (200) -> embeddings 402 {"reason":"org.billing_pending", "message":"billing pending verification"}`. The sample app shows a spinner for a long time because SDK retries on 402.

raj: 402 is supposed to be terminal for billing states. Why is SDK configured to retry on 402? That sounds like a generic retry rule for 4xx/5xx we added last quarter.

claire: SDK backoff rules are aggressive right now: retries on 429/5xx and some unexpected 4xx when the request is considered idempotent. Embeddings call was flagged idempotent, so it retried. We should not retry for `org.billing_*` reasons.

devex-bot: Related doc: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/onboarding-billing which recommends returning `help_url` in the response body when gating by billing.

emma: The response did not include help_url. Customer complained console helped, but having a direct link in the API body would have saved them a ticket.

raj: Short-term mitigation: update the Node and Python SDKs to treat 402 with reasons matching `org.billing_*` as non-retriable and surface a typed BillingRequiredError that includes the body message. I'll open PRs.

claire: Also let's add a tiny preflight to the quickstart that calls `/v1/onboarding/check` (internal only) to verify workspace readiness before exercising both endpoints. That can detect `billing_pending` and show a banner with the console link.

support: Workaround we gave the customer: owner must complete billing verification (console -> Billing -> Verify). If owner is not available, create a temporary dev workspace for onboarding. I attached the path in TKT-7332.

emma: Can we also standardize reason strings? I worry `org.billing_pending` vs `org.billing_unverified` vs `org.billing_consent_required` are all over the place and SDKs need to check all three.

raj: Good point. I'll coordinate with API team to publish a canonical list of onboarding reasons in the openapi spec and add stable enum `billing_state` to the onboarding endpoint.

devex-bot: Suggested owners: @raj for SDK changes (node#5720), @claire for quickstart preflight (repo: quickstarts/docs). ETA: 72h for SDK PRs, quickstart patch in 48h.

emma: Customer verified billing during this thread and embeddings started working. Marking TKT-7332 resolved. Filing follow-up to ensure `help_url` is present in responses going forward.

claire: I'll add a tiny paragraph to the quickstart README about "If embeddings fail with billing error" with console link examples.

raj: I'll add unit tests to confirm SDK does not retry these reasons and that the error includes a help_url when present. Also logging should include `billing_state` for easier triage.

emma: Thanks team. This is a good small DX win ":sparkles:"

devex-bot: Tags: @sdk-team @quickstart @support.
